§6Stirling Engine§f

§aHeat in, electricity out. But push it too hard and things get... violent.§f

Place it directly above a heat source (firebox, heating oven). Runs at 50% efficiency. Craft at a Tier 2 anvil.

§cWARNING:§f Max safe input is §e300 TU/t§f (150 HE/t). Go over and you'll hear a warning. Keep going and the engine launches its gear like a projectile. Destroys blocks, kills entities. The gear is retrievable, but your base might not be.

§6Heavy Variant§f handles §e1,500 TU/t§f. Needs beryllium, gold coils, and a large steel gear at a Tier 2 anvil.

§ePS:§f Stick to lignite or charcoal with the standard engine. Use the heavy variant for rocket fuel or blaze rods.
